verdict.rationale: Missive documents a ⌘/Ctrl+K command bar that can run actions such as snooze and search across messages, contacts and labels, with a docs page on keyboard shortcuts and quick commands. Canned responses insert with a few keystrokes, and a hands-on user calls Missive a 'proper snappy desktop app', which supports the speed claim. missing for 10: an evidenced comprehensive shortcut reference, proof that every action is reachable from the keyboard, and independent performance measurements.
